products.title: Lakshmi Nakshi Temple Vaddanam
products.description: A hand-finished Nakshi temple vaddanam with a central Goddess Lakshmi medallion, intricate peacock carvings and a flexible link band that sits flat on silk sarees. Made for weddings, Varalakshmi Vratham and Seemantham — the authentic look of a 22K heirloom at a fraction of the cost.

products.title: Peacock Kempu Stone Hip Belt
products.description: A lightweight hip belt studded with ruby-red Kempu stones and twin peacock motifs. The adjustable hook fits waists from 26 to 40 inches, making it a perfect gift for half-saree functions and bridal trousseaus.

products.title: Lakshmi Coin Nallapusalu Long Chain
products.description: Traditional double-line nallapusalu with glossy black beads, gold spacer balls and a pair of Lakshmi kasulu at the centre. Designed for daily wear by newly-weds who want the auspicious look without risking real gold.

products.title: Traditional Gold Bead Nallapusalu
products.description: A short single-line nallapusalu with alternating gold beads — comfortable enough for office and elegant enough for poojas. Pairs beautifully with a mangalsutra pendant.

products.title: Nakshi Lakshmi Choker Set with Jhumkas
products.description: An antique Nakshi choker with Lakshmi engravings, pearl drops and matching temple jhumkas. Adjustable dori at the back so it sits perfectly with blouses of any neckline.

products.title: Kempu & Emerald Bridal Choker Set
products.description: Ruby-red Kempu and emerald-green stones set in a broad bridal choker with a matching pair of chandbali earrings. Our bestseller for Pellikuthuru and reception looks.

products.title: Micro Gold Plated Bangles (Set of 4)
products.description: Four slim bangles with diamond-cut Nakshi patterns that catch the light with every movement. Stack them with glass bangles for festivals or wear two for everyday elegance.

products.title: Guttapusalu Long Haram
products.description: A statement guttapusalu haram with clusters of pearl and gold beads cascading from a Kempu-studded mango mala. The centrepiece of any bridal jewellery set.

products.title: AAA Swiss CZ Bridal Necklace Set
products.description: Hand-set AAA grade Swiss cubic zirconia in a rhodium-plated necklace with matching earrings. Real-diamond fire for receptions, engagements and sangeet nights.

products.title: Rose Gold CZ Cocktail Ring
products.description: A halo cocktail ring with a brilliant-cut AAA CZ centre stone in a soft rose gold finish. The open band adjusts to fit most fingers.

products.title: Waterproof PVD Gold Paperclip Chain
products.description: A sleek paperclip chain in 316L surgical stainless steel with 18K gold-tone PVD coating. Shower-proof, sweat-proof and hypoallergenic — wear it to the gym, the office and the beach at RK Beach without a second thought.

products.title: Anti-Tarnish Butterfly Huggie Earrings
products.description: Chunky everyday huggies with a tiny butterfly charm. 316L steel with PVD gold — no green ears, no fading, no fuss.

products.title: Minimal PVD Office-Wear Bracelet
products.description: A slim cuff-style bracelet with a single CZ accent, built for long days at HITEC City desks. Waterproof PVD coating keeps the shine through hand-washes and sanitiser.

products.title: Korean Pearl Drop Earrings
products.description: Featherlight freshwater-look pearl drops on gold-tone hooks — the K-drama staple that goes from college to cafe to sangeet.

products.title: K-Trend Heart Pendant Necklace
products.description: A puffed heart pendant on a fine anti-tarnish chain, inspired by Tollywood and K-pop street style. Layer it or wear it solo.
